sentences.text: The Green-veined white is an insect in the order Lepidoptera.
In Mainz-Bingen, 569 reports have been logged in ten years, with a main time from April to September and most reports in July.
It has been recorded eating Oregano, Cuckoo Flower, field scabious and Tufted Vetch.
It has been recorded visiting flowers of Garlic Mustard, Daisy, Ground Ivy and Alfalfa.
